content: Umbaana Raja Momulia i Nuncana Baitulla

content.text: KAWASANA OPU mokopewauaakana alamu tee bhari-bharia antona,
dunia tee bhari-bharia momboorena i nuncana.
Incia modhikana kalempesina alamu i bhawona tawo,
tee apakaroa i bhawona manga umala.
Incema momembalina mopenena i gununa KAWASANA OPU?
Tee incema momembalina moumbana i aroana tampa momangkilona?
Mia momangkilona limana tee momalapena incana,
incia inda adoʼa i manga barahala,
tee inda aposumpa gau-gau.
Incia bheapotibhaaka barakati minaaka i KAWASANA OPU,
tee Aulataʼala mopasalaamatia bheapabanarea.
Siimo manga mia mopeelona Aulataʼala,
aumba to asomba Ingkoo, Aulataʼalana Yakub. Sela
Pobungkalemo pekaewa, e manga bhambana lawa!
Toangkamo, e manga bhamba motopakarona minaaka i piamo itu,
mamudhaakana Raja Momulia apesua!
Incema o Raja Momulia sumai?
KAWASANA OPU, momakaana tee mohebana!
KAWASANA OPU, mohebana i nuncana potimbea!
Pobungkalemo pekaewa, e manga bhambana lawa!
Toangkamo, e manga bhamba motopakarona minaaka i piamo itu,
mamudhaakana Raja Momulia apesua!
"Incema buaka Raja momulia sumai?"
KAWASANA OPUNA saangua alamu,
Incia Raja Momulia! Sela
